latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the play-guitar-fretboard skill.

- Provides a simple navigation tool for quick access to core guitar fretboard learning resources.
- One-click redirection to www.changesway.com with visualizations, scale, chord, and fingering materials.
- Supports natural language triggers for ease of use.
- No dependencies, API keys, or scripts required—just direct access to resources.
- Ideal for guitar beginners seeking quality fretboard study materials.
